title: Lazy
description: x-lazy defers an image: it sets the host's src (and srcset) only when the host scrolls into view, shows a placeholder box until then, and fires wb:lazy:loaded once the image has loaded. Without src it shows a warning.

src.description: The image URL to load when the host comes into view. Required.

srcset.description: A responsive srcset, set together with src.

threshold.description: How much of the host, from 0 to 1, must be visible before the image loads.

_metadata.derivedFrom: helpers.js lazy() — every property here is one the behavior reads
